Introduction

This week, I was able to add some per-season maps, add some consistency plots, look at the scatter plot by urbanicity quartile, and trim the code file into a separate file for easy use.

Data Loading

d = readRDS("../report_data_cache.rds")
list2env(d, envir = .GlobalEnv)
## <environment: R_GlobalEnv>
lower48 = setdiff(c(state.name, "District of Columbia"), c("Alaska",
    "Hawaii"))

cat("Filtered rows:", nrow(diff_peak_filtered), "\n")
## Filtered rows: 1947

Timing

diff_peak_filtered %>%
    group_by(peak_window) %>%
    summarise(cor_signed_lag = cor(truth_time_diff, signed_lag,
        use = "complete.obs"), cor_mean_abs_lag = cor(truth_time_diff_abs,
        mean_abs_lag, use = "complete.obs"), cor_centroid_signed = cor(centroid_time_diff,
        signed_lag, use = "complete.obs"), cor_centroid_abs = cor(centroid_time_diff_abs,
        mean_abs_lag, use = "complete.obs"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Timing metric correlations by peak window")
Timing metric correlations by peak window
peak_window cor_signed_lag cor_mean_abs_lag cor_centroid_signed cor_centroid_abs
1 0.446 0.317 0.644 0.507
2 0.385 0.198 0.542 0.456
3 0.274 0.207 0.442 0.281 
centroid_lm = lm(centroid_time_diff ~ signed_lag * factor(peak_window),
    data = diff_peak_filtered)
diff_peak_filtered$pred_timing = predict(centroid_lm, newdata = diff_peak_filtered)

ggplot(diff_peak_filtered, aes(x = signed_lag, y = centroid_time_diff,
    fill = as.factor(peak_window))) + geom_point(pch = 21, color = "black",
    alpha = 0.5) + geom_line(aes(y = pred_timing), color = "firebrick",
    lwd = 1.1) + facet_wrap(~peak_window) + theme_bw() + labs(x = "DTW signed lag",
    y = "True timing diff (centroid)", title = "Signed lag vs. centroid timing difference by window") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

diff_peak_filtered %>%
    group_by(peak_window) %>%
    summarise(r2 = summary(lm(centroid_time_diff ~ signed_lag))$r.squared,
        n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Timing R² by window")
Timing R² by window
peak_window r2 n

Magnitude

    group_by(peak_window) %>%
    summarise(cor_frechet = cor(truth_mag_ratio, frechet, use = "complete.obs"),

            dtw_rmse, use = "complete.obs"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Magnitude metric correlations by peak window")

Magnitude Ratio Consistency

mag_consistency = truth_peaks %>%
    filter(state_peak_value > 0, hsa_peak_value > 0, truth_mag_ratio >
        0, truth_mag_ratio < 5) %>%
    group_by(ID, state) %>%
    mutate(direction = case_when(all(truth_mag_ratio > 1, na.rm = TRUE) ~
        "Always HSA > State", all(truth_mag_ratio < 1, na.rm = TRUE) ~
        "Always HSA < State", TRUE ~ "Inconsistent")) %>%
    ungroup()

mag_consistency %>%
    distinct(ID, direction) %>%
    count(direction) %>%
    mutate(pct = round(n/sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = "HSA magnitude direction consistency")
HSA magnitude direction consistency
direction n pct
Always HSA < State 75 11.2
Always HSA > State 323 48.1
Inconsistent 273 40.7 
ggplot(mag_consistency, aes(x = factor(peak_window), y = truth_mag_ratio,
    group = ID, color = direction)) + geom_line(alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.4) + geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black", lwd = 0.8) + scale_color_manual(values = c(`Always HSA > State` = "#d73027",
    `Always HSA < State` = "#4575b4", Inconsistent = "gray60")) +
    theme_bw() + labs(x = "Peak window", y = "HSA / State peak ratio",
    title = "Per-HSA magnitude ratio consistency across seasons",
    color = NULL)

Lag Consistency

lag_consistency = diff_peak_filtered %>%
    group_by(ID, state) %>%
    summarise(all_same_sign = length(unique(sign(signed_lag[!is.na(signed_lag)]))) ==
        1, mean_signed_lag = mean(signed_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
        lag_truth_agree = mean(sign(signed_lag) == sign(truth_time_diff),
            na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

lag_consistency %>%
    count(all_same_sign) %>%
    mutate(pct = round(n/sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = "Lag sign consistency across windows")

US Maps

win_labels = c(`1` = "Window 1", `2` = "Window 2", `3` = "Window 3")

# Per-window: raw metric averages (correlations would have
# only 1 row per group)
hsa_window_vals = diff_peak_filtered %>%
    group_by(ID, state, peak_window) %>%
    summarise(mean_signed_lag = mean(signed_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_frechet = mean(frechet, na.rm = TRUE), mean_mag_ratio = mean(truth_mag_ratio,
            na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

us_map_window = us_map %>%
    filter(state %in% lower48) %>%
    crossing(peak_window = c(1, 2, 3)) %>%
    left_join(hsa_window_vals %>%
        rename(hsa_nci_id = ID), by = c("hsa_nci_id", "state",
        "peak_window"))

# Pooled correlations (3 windows per HSA, so cor() has
# observations to work with)
hsa_cors = diff_peak_filtered %>%
    group_by(ID, state) %>%
    summarise(cor_timing = cor(signed_lag, centroid_time_diff,
        use = "complete.obs"), cor_mag = cor(frechet, truth_mag_ratio,
        use = "complete.obs"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(composite = cor_timing + cor_mag)

us_map_cors = us_map %>%
    filter(state %in% lower48) %>%
    left_join(hsa_cors %>%
        rename(hsa_nci_id = ID), by = c("hsa_nci_id", "state"))

# Helper
seasonal_map = function(data, fill_var, title, limits = c(-1,
    1)) {
    ggplot() + geom_sf(data = st_set_geometry(st_as_sf(data),
        "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = .data[[fill_var]]), color = "gray20",
        linewidth = 0.1) + geom_sf(data = st_set_geometry(st_as_sf(data),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
        scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
            midpoint = 0, limits = limits, na.value = "gray90",
            name = "Value") + facet_wrap(~peak_window, ncol = 1,
        labeller = labeller(peak_window = win_labels)) + coord_sf() +
        theme_void() + labs(title = title)
}
seasonal_map(us_map_window, "mean_signed_lag", "Mean signed lag by season (negative = HSA leads state)")

seasonal_map(us_map_window, "mean_mag_ratio", "Mean HSA / State magnitude ratio by season",
    limits = c(0, 3))

seasonal_map(us_map_window, "mean_frechet", "Mean Fréchet distance by season",
    limits = c(0, 25))

us_map_cors %>%
    left_join(lag_consistency %>%
        rename(hsa_nci_id = ID) %>%
        select(hsa_nci_id, mean_signed_lag), by = "hsa_nci_id") %>%
    {
        ggplot() + geom_sf(data = st_set_geometry(st_as_sf(.),
            "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = mean_signed_lag), color = "gray20",
            linewidth = 0.1) + geom_sf(data = st_set_geometry(st_as_sf(.),
            "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
            scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white",
                high = "red", midpoint = 0, na.value = "gray90",
                name = "Mean\nsigned lag") + coord_sf() + theme_void() +
            labs(title = "Mean signed lag per HSA (pooled, negative = HSA leads state)")
    }

us_map_cors %>%
    left_join(diff_peak_filtered %>%
        group_by(ID, state) %>%
        summarise(mean_mag_ratio = mean(truth_mag_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
        rename(hsa_nci_id = ID), by = "hsa_nci_id") %>%
    {
        ggplot() + geom_sf(data = st_set_geometry(st_as_sf(.),
            "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = mean_mag_ratio), color = "gray20",
            linewidth = 0.1) + geom_sf(data = st_set_geometry(st_as_sf(.),
            "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
            scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white",
                high = "red", midpoint = 1, limits = c(0.5, 2),
                oob = scales::squish, na.value = "gray90", name = "Mean\nmag ratio") +
            coord_sf() + theme_void() + labs(title = "Mean HSA / State magnitude ratio per HSA (pooled, red = HSA peaks higher)")
    }

HSA Characteristics vs. Correlation Scores

cor_table = us_map_cors %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(-geometry_hsa, -geometry_county) %>%
    mutate(area_ratio = area_km2_hsa/area_km2_state) %>%
    distinct(hsa_nci_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(cor_timing, cor_mag, composite, pct_urban, pop_ratio,
        log_density_hsa, area_ratio) %>%
    mutate(log_pop_ratio = log(pop_ratio + 1e-06), log_area_ratio = log(area_ratio +
        1e-06)) %>%
    select(-pop_ratio, -area_ratio)
cor(cor_table, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")[c("cor_timing",
    "cor_mag", "composite"), c("pct_urban", "log_density_hsa",
    "log_pop_ratio", "log_area_ratio")] %>%
    round(3) %>%
    knitr::kable(caption = "Correlation of HSA characteristics with correlation scores")
Correlation of HSA characteristics with correlation scores
pct_urban log_density_hsa log_pop_ratio log_area_ratio
cor_timing 0.012 -0.121 -0.072 -0.064
cor_mag 0.025 -0.217 -0.213 -0.110
composite 0.028 -0.251 -0.215 -0.129 
predictor_labels = c(pct_urban = "% Urban", log_pop_ratio = "log(Pop ratio)",
    log_density_hsa = "log(HSA density)", log_area_ratio = "log(Area ratio)")

outcome_labels = c(cor_timing = "Timing correlation", cor_mag = "Magnitude correlation",
    composite = "Composite")

cor_table %>%
    mutate(urban_class = cut(pct_urban, breaks = quantile(pct_urban,
        probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), na.rm = TRUE), labels = c("Q1 Rural",
        "Q2 Low-Urban", "Q3 Urban", "Q4 High-Urban"), include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(pct_urban, log_pop_ratio, log_density_hsa,
        log_area_ratio), names_to = "predictor", values_to = "predictor_value") %>%
    pivot_longer(c(cor_timing, cor_mag, composite), names_to = "outcome",
        values_to = "outcome_value") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = predictor_value, y = outcome_value, color = urban_class)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 0.8) + facet_grid(outcome ~
    predictor, scales = "free_x", labeller = labeller(predictor = predictor_labels,
    outcome = outcome_labels)) + scale_color_brewer(palette = "RdYlBu",
    direction = -1, na.value = "gray80") + theme_bw() + labs(x = "Predictor value",
    y = "Correlation score", title = "HSA correlation scores vs. characteristics, by urbanicity quartile",
    color = "Urban class")

Conclusion

I’m a little unsure how to interpret some of these US maps but it looks good, I think I will use the large ones in my poster because they look nice and are easy to read.
